reuse.why: Changes the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and replaces schedule-template's hand-rolled stepping loop with the existing getNextDateAfter helper.

duplication.why: Removes the duplicated weekend-adjust blocks in schedule-template; the only repetition left is the search-window idea, a named WEEKEND_SEARCH_WINDOW in shared/schedules.ts and a bare `count * 7` in getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The daily rule lives in the shared weekend helper in shared/schedules.ts, and parseRecurDate carries the frequency the helper needs.

scope.why: Focused on the weekend rule; the schedule-template loop rewrite goes a bit beyond the request but is the consequence of routing that site through the shared definition.

maintainability.why: One rule, every caller routed through it, with tests; the helper's nullable return and the frequency string parameter add a small burden callers must handle.

one_place.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts (daily => null), used by getNextDate (and so getNextDateAfter/schedule-template) and by getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts
